mapper.select:
/* BmsMobBwloMapper.selectLocationStock : 로케이션재고확인 - 재고수량 조회 */
SELECT MAX(I.LOCATION_PLACE) AS LOCATION_PLACE , MAX(LOC.NAME_DEFAULT) AS LOCATION_NAME , SUM(I.STOCK_CT) AS SUM_STOCK_CT FROM TB_BMS_IN I WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL LOC ON I.LOCATION_PLACE = LOC.CODE AND LOC.GROUP_CODE = 'WH_LOCATION' WHERE I.BL_NO = #{srchWhLocation}

/* BmsMobBwloMapper.selectLocationInfoDetail : 로케이션적치 - 로케이션정보 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 CODE AS LOCATION_PLACE , NAME_DEFAULT AS LOCATION_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL LOC WHERE LOC.GROUP_CODE = 'WH_LOCATION' AND LOC.CODE = #{srchWhLocation}

/* BmsMobBwloMapper.selectLocationCarryInDetail : 로케이션적치 - 반입 조회 */
SELECT I.OD_JOB_NO, I.BL_NO, I.STOCK_CT, /* 수량 */ I.STOCK_WT, /* 중량 */ ISNULL(SIC.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 선별 */ ISNULL(SIC2.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* XRAY */ ISNULL(SIC3.NAME_DEFAULT,'') AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE_NAME, /* 관 */ 'Y' AS SCAN_YN, /* 스캔 */ SUBSTRING(I.CARRYIN_DATE+ ' ' + I.CARRYIN_TIME, 3, LEN(I.CARRYIN_DATE+ ' ' + I.CARRYIN_TIME)) AS CARRYIN_DATE_TIME, /* 반입일시 */ I.LOCATION_PLACE, /* 장치위치 1) */ ISNULL(LOC.NAME_KOR,'') AS LOCATION_PLACE_NAME /* 장치위치 2) */ FROM TB_BMS_IN I WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL LOC ON I.LOCATION_PLACE = LOC.CODE AND LOC.GROUP_CODE = 'WH_LOCATION' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL CD ON I.CD_TYPE = CD.CODE AND CD.GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL SIC ON I.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = SIC.CODE AND SIC.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL SIC2 ON I.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = SIC2.CODE AND SIC2.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL SIC3 ON I.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = SIC3.CODE AND SIC3.GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE' LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_LOCAL_INSPECT_RESULT LIR ON I.IN_NO = LIR.IN_NO WHERE I.IN_NO = #{srchNo} ORDER BY I.LOCATION_PLACE
